object.description: Give an enumeration attribute a value that isn't one of its options through MCP set_attribute, new_object, update_object and bulk_set_attribute, through a grid cell, and through an Inspector field. Expected: each is refused, the error names the value or the attribute, and the object file keeps its old value.
